task: Deepen (flagship 9) league-schedule-generator: back-to-back lane repeats in the SAT-table bowling seasons (NEXT.md item)

errors.what: A shell waiter that ran batch 2 after batch 1 used pgrep -f '[b]owling-repeat-sat.py' inside a command line that itself contained 'bowling-repeat-sat.py', so it matched itself and never fired; cost ~30 min of idle wait before it was killed and batch 2 started by hand.

Raising the anneal's step budget alone did not monotonically help (500k steps: 284 repeats vs 269 at 200k); the out-of-bounds weight mattered far more (3: 369, 1: 269). Settled at weight 1, T0 0.6, 600k steps.

doc_friction.issue: python-sat was not installed; `pip install` silently installed to a different interpreter than /usr/local/bin/python3 (no error, module still missing); `python3 -m pip install python-sat` worked. Worth a line next to the pyenv.py advice.

deviations.why: The merge keeps the stored answer with fewer repeats, but what matters is the page's season after polish and anneal; three entries were judged by hand on page-level repeats (20x40 reverted, 24x26 and 24x34 dropped) rather than coding that selection into the merge.
deviations.did: Compared main and branch with eval/bowling-repeat-table.mjs per key and edited three entries.
deviations.result: Page repeats 787 -> 439 on 38 seasons, none worse than main.

writeups: ventures/league-schedule-generator/README.md (Bowling: fewer weeks on the same pair running, 2026-11-18)
notes: Bowling lane repeats: cutRepeats anneal in assignLanes (keeps only in-target seasons) + stored SAT answers re-solved with a totalizer cap on repeats (eval/bowling-repeat-sat.py, 400 s each, 38 seasons). 36-season grid 392 -> 148 repeats, 36/36 still at the bound; stored/pinned seasons 787 -> 439; 12x18/24/30 and 10x30 at 0 repeats with exact balance (proved least on 9 seasons). No agent doc in docs/reports: README section and NEXT.md carry what the next run needs. Verification: bowling.test.mjs targeted runs pass; full venture suite and venture-preflight results in PR body.
